children: Resources Connection, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $98.09M, a decline from $120.23M a year earlier, and a net loss of ($7.97M) compared with a loss of ($2.41M) in the prior-year quarter; diluted loss per share was ($0.23) versus ($0.07) a year ago.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.
Revenue fell about 18% year over year, driven by lower billable hours and softer consulting demand.
Customer mix shifted toward lower‑rate geographies, notably Asia Pacific, and consulting project volume decreased.
The company continued to expand Consulting and On‑Demand Talent capabilities, focusing on AI, ERP and finance transformation.
Operational moves included the sale of Sitrick, launch of a 2026 Transformation Initiative and workforce reductions to simplify operations.
Management is investing in sales capacity and consulting leadership in phases to capture future demand.
